column3: MT 4:3. Close to the Hebrew; “they exchanged the boy for the prostitute” is rendered “Have given a boy as payment for a harlot.”
MT 4:4. Close to the Hebrew; “the territories of Philistia” is rendered “the coasts of Philistia,” and “recompense” “retaliation.”
MT 4:9. Close to the Hebrew; “consecrate a war” is rendered “Prepare for war!”
MT 4:10. Close to the Hebrew; “I am a warrior” is rendered “I am strong.”
MT 4:11. Close to the Hebrew; “hurry” is rendered “Assemble.”
MT 4:13. Close to the Hebrew; “come, tread” is rendered “Come, go down.”
MT 4:15. Close to the Hebrew; the past “have become dark” is rendered as future, “will grow dark.”
MT 4:16. Close to the Hebrew; “a stronghold” is rendered “the strength.”
MT 4:18. Close to the Hebrew; “the wadi of Shittim” is rendered “the Valley of Acacias.”

MT 4:21. Close to the Hebrew; “I will leave unpunished their blood [that] I have not left unpunished” is rendered “I will acquit them of the guilt of bloodshed, whom I had not acquitted”; the meaning is uncertain.
